title: Everything Announced at MongoDB.local NYC 2026
summary: Explore major announcements from MongoDB.local NYC 2026, including MongoDB 9.0, Atlas Infinite, and Atlas Agent Engine. Read the full recap now.
body_markdown:
MongoDB.local NYC 2026 is officially a wrap, and what an event it was!


An array of analysts, builders, businesspeople, caterers, engineers, fire marshals, media members, photographers, and trained elephants* chose to spend the day with us at Pier 36 in downtown New York, and we couldn’t be more thrilled. We just hope everyone had half as much fun as we did (it was a lot of fun).


The theme of this year’s event was how developers and enterprises can build anything and change everything with MongoDB. We released capabilities that make building AI applications and agents easier and faster for customers of all sizes—proving that MongoDB is *the* intelligent data platform for modern applications in the multi-cloud and AI era.


Specifically, the general availability of[MongoDB 9.0, and the public previews of Atlas Infinite](https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/ai-demand-constant-unpredictable-extreme-mongodb-is-built-for-it) and[Atlas Agent Engine](https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/how-atlas-agent-engine-powers-mongodbs-internal-ai-strategy) represent the most significant expansion of our platform yet. Meanwhile, Voyage AI by MongoDB’s best-in-class retrieval capabilities—as measured by the[Retrieval Embedding Benchmark](https://huggingface.co/spaces/embedding-benchmark/RTEB) (RTEB)—give agents and applications better accuracy at lower cost.


But those were hardly the only announcements we shared! Read on for details about everything launched at[MongoDB.local NYC 2026](https://www.mongodb.com/events/mongodb-local/nyc) .


## MongoDB Atlas: The multi-cloud, intelligent data platform


Built for real-time operational data, best-in-class retrieval (with hybrid search and models from


[Voyage AI by MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/products/platform/ai-search-and-retrieval) ), and for running agents in production, MongoDB Atlas offers organizations a single platform to build, deploy, and manage AI applications and agents at any scale, across any cloud, on their terms.


Here’s everything we announced related to MongoDB Atlas:


- **Atlas Infinite (Public Preview)**
-


**Atlas Agent Engine (Public Preview)**


-


**Atlas Ephemeral Clusters (Public Preview)**


-


**Atlas SQL Dedicated Cluster (GA)**


-


**New Metrics UI in Atlas (GA)**


## MongoDB 9.0: The best version of MongoDB, ever


MongoDB 9.0 is the best-performing version of the world's most popular document database. MongoDB 9.0 strengthens the foundation customers already run on, with major gains in performance, security, and scalability.


Here’s everything we announced related to MongoDB 9.0:


- **MongoDB 9.0 (GA)**
-


**Intelligent Workload Management (GA)**


-


**Queryable Encryption prefix and suffix query support (GA)**


-


**MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM (GA)**


## Best-in-class search and retrieval


Every answer, decision, and action an AI agent takes depends on retrieving accurate, relevant information. Better retrieval helps agents understand enterprise data more accurately, consume fewer tokens, and act more confidently in production.


MongoDB is dedicated to empowering customers to build retrieval systems that agents can rely on. Today’s announcements build on that foundation, further improving retrieval accuracy, reducing operational overhead, and giving teams more control over where their content is processed.


Here’s everything we announced related to search and retrieval:


- **Voyage rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite (GA)**
-


**Europe Data Residency for Atlas Embedding and Reranking (GA)**


-


**Native Reranking (GA)**


-


**Accelerated Search Aggregations (Public Preview)**


## From thinking (and prototyping) to acting at scale


The announcements we shared at MongoDB.local NYC 2026 help customers move from prototype to production quickly.


They also build on an already-rock-solid foundation—our platform serves more than three trillion queries a day, and ~75% of the Fortune 100 rely on MongoDB for critical applications. Together, the launches of MongoDB 9.0, Atlas Infinite, and Atlas Agent Engine (+ Voyage AI’s industry-leading models) make MongoDB the intelligent data platform for modern applications in the multi-cloud and AI era.


###### Next Steps


For everything we announced at MongoDB.local NYC—as well as the latest product updates—visit our[What's New](https://www.mongodb.com/products/updates) page.


Get started with these new capabilities today for free at[mongodb.com/atlas](http://mongodb.com/atlas) . And to build the skills to move AI agents from prototype to production,[explore MongoDB's new Skill Badges](https://learn.mongodb.com/skills?team=content&sort=newest&filter=topic%3AGen+AI) in governance, observability, and agentic platform evaluation.


*Note that there were no trained elephants at MongoDB.local NYC 2026, sadly. Next year!?
